name: smart-handoff
description: Smart Handoff plugin. Implements a runtime-agnostic, token-optimized protocol for pausing and resuming long AI coding sessions. When approaching context or usage budgets (~90-95%+), it saves a resumable snapshot of state, commits, pushes, and stops, enabling any runtime (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity/Agy, OpenCode, Gemini CLI) to cleanly resume.
